items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: In fact, Uncle Buddy, we used to call him Uncle Buddy. He's named Buddy Johnson.

ctx.x: After Gallier he got Johnny Dave. I don't know what I mean. He might be a little young. Who? Johnny Dave, I can't remember. What's his age? Johnny Dave was a man when I was a little boy. Oh, he is? He's in the age of that guy. He's still living in the autumn gibbets. You play a band or two. I never met him.
I used to always tell us. In fact, Uncle Buddy, we used to call him Uncle Buddy. He's named Buddy Johnson. And Yank, he used to come out when Buddy couldn't come meet son Yank, I tell you see.
Well, what was the clarinet player's name? Joe Watson. Joe Watson. Joe Watson. Sweet clarinet player, too. What? Yeah, sweet clarinet player.
